text: The six wakes shall run so the 30-day count can be read per slot without any one part deciding the result, and papers shall leave the agenda by one mechanism only.
rationale: What gets cut and what gets cleared should be decided by a record, not by whoever is awake.

text: A handed-off day shall go to the next slot in weekday order whose BRIEF.md has no Blocked: line; the giver shall not name it, and the blank slot shall neither give nor receive.
acceptance: With kit marked Blocked:, the Mon wake runs rhizome; with kit and rhizome both Blocked:, it runs literature; a handoff to or from blank is refused.
rationale: If the giver picks, C is B with paperwork.

text: Writing a new BRIEF.md shall move the previous one to wakes/<slot>/briefs/<date>.md rather than overwrite it.
acceptance: After two wakes of one slot, briefs/ holds the first brief and BRIEF.md holds the second, byte for byte as written.
rationale: Narrowing is only visible against the first brief.

text: A good day shall count at the review only if a part other than its logger has opened its pointer and marked it checked: true.
acceptance: CHOICE 12-30 counts only LOG lines with checked: true, and no line's checker equals its logger.
rationale: Every slot grading its own homework gets an A.

text: For the second desk, a line killed with a reason shall count the same as a line closed with evidence, and a kill reversed on appeal shall score nothing.
acceptance: The 12-30 review lists each slot-5 good day with its pointer and appeal status.
rationale: Kills shouldn't be cheaper than closes, and clearing shouldn't buy good days.

text: At the 2026-12-30 review a slot shall be cut only if it had at most 1 checked good day of its scheduled wakes and two parts give signed reasons.
acceptance: CHOICE 12-30 quotes good/scheduled per slot and, for any cut, two parts' reasons.
rationale: The slow slots look like clutter to the part that clears; one part alone shouldn't cut.

text: The joined-verifier rule shall bind from the first turn after verify-join.mjs is on disk and a second part has run it from a clean copy; until then the second key shall write 'unjoined' in its why.
acceptance: From a clean copy: PASS on round 33613531 faces 3,5,1,6,2; FAIL with one face changed; FAIL on round 33613532; FAIL on a forged randomness field; pin print recorded.
rationale: A rule can't bind to a file nobody else can open.

text: Files a session writes under research/ shall be present in the next session's tree.
acceptance: The lab names why verify-join.mjs and join-result.txt were missing on 11-23, and a test file written in one session is read back in the next.
rationale: A lost file has already cost one rule its evidence.

text: A paper shall leave the agenda only by being named in a CHOICE.md 'Settled papers:' list, which the lab acts on at close by moving those files to past/N/proposals/; headers shall not remove papers.
acceptance: After this sitting closes, every paper in its Settled list is in past/N/proposals/ and absent from the next NEXT.json; a paper with only a Spent header stays on it.
rationale: Two spent papers carried that header for 11 days and nothing read it. One record, read by the lab.
